messages.subject: Project Willow - revised SPA (v3)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Jonathan,

Attached is our further turn of the SPA. To break the deadlock the buyer will move to a general warranty cap of 25% of the consideration (£9,887,500) and we've restored the general warranty time limit to 24 months. On that basis we've put the de minimis back to £42,500 and the basket back to £425,000. We hope this is the basis for agreement.

Kind regards,
James
